name: amp
pronunciation_note: Owner request 2026-11-04. One syllable, short a as in English 'amp'; German speakers say it the same way. The bare form is short and common, so the addressed head (hey_amp) is the trigger and the bare head needs the owner's listening before anything binds it. 'Amt' (German) devoices to amt, not amp: a near-miss, not a homophone.
